'''July 1999 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Things For Thinkers, Tucson, Arizona on 31 July 1999. It is known from Josh Latneau's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d4">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99d4/ things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99], DeckTech (Josh "Momaw Nadon" Latneau, 11 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99d4/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 July 1999
* '''Site:''' Things For Thinkers, Tucson, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
